context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 user feedback items have been implemented and verified. Severity statuses now use: operational_minor (green), operational_fault (yellow), out_of_order (red). Legacy values (low, medium, critical) are mapped to new labels for display. H&S disclaimer banner is visible on Risk Assessment tab with data-testid='risk-assessment-disclaimer'. Gym Layout tab renamed from 'Gym Design'. Duplicate machine bug was found and fixed during this iteration.

guidance_text.operational_minor: Machine is fully usable — minor fault or annoyance. Examples: Cosmetic damage, slight noise, loose trim, worn decals
guidance_text.operational_fault: Machine works but not as intended — could worsen if ignored. Examples: Resistance not accurate, console intermittent, belt slipping slightly, unusual noise under load
guidance_text.out_of_order: Cannot be used — must be taken out of service. Examples: Will not power on, unsafe to use, major mechanical failure
